title.zh: 古代工程奇迹：桥、运河与宫殿

clips.send: Tongzhou. Today: Tongzhou District, Beijing. Grain boats from the south unloaded here at the northern end of the canal. Today Tongzhou is Beijing’s new sub-centre for city government offices.
clips.text: Tongzhou. Today: Tongzhou District, Beijing. Grain boats from the south unloaded here at the northern end of the canal. Today Tongzhou is Beijing’s new sub-centre for city government offices.

clips.send: Beijing. China’s capital and its political and cultural centre. The Forbidden City, the palace of the Ming and Qing emperors, is in the middle of the city.
clips.text: Beijing. China’s capital and its political and cultural centre. The Forbidden City, the palace of the Ming and Qing emperors, is in the middle of the city.

clips.send: Lugou (Marco Polo) Bridge. Today: southwest of Beijing. A stone bridge from 1192 with nearly 500 carved lions. Japanese troops attacked here in 1937, and all of China rose to resist.
clips.text: Lugou (Marco Polo) Bridge. Today: southwest of Beijing. A stone bridge from 1192 with nearly 500 carved lions. Japanese troops attacked here in 1937, and all of China rose to resist.

clips.send: Yingxian Wooden Pagoda. Today: Ying County, Shanxi. About 67 m tall and made entirely of wood without nails, it has stood for over 950 years and survived earthquakes.
clips.text: Yingxian Wooden Pagoda. Today: Ying County, Shanxi. About 67 m tall and made entirely of wood without nails, it has stood for over 950 years and survived earthquakes.

clips.send: Column and lintel. Already in place: the red column and the beam along its top. Palace columns are huge single tree trunks, painted red. They stand on stone bases (柱础) instead of being buried in the ground.
clips.text: Column and lintel。Already in place: the red column and the beam along its top。Palace columns are huge single tree trunks, painted red.。They stand on stone bases (柱础) instead of being buried in the ground.

clips.send: MORTISE and TENON. Through tenon. A square peg pushed right through a hole in the column. Through tenon. Dovetail. Slide “Assemble” to push the beam’s tenon (榫) into the column’s mortise (卯). The joint holds by shape and friction, no nails, no glue. In a quake it can turn a little and rub, soaking up energy, then settle back.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Dougong are not just decoration. They carry the roof, push the eaves far out, and soften earthquake shaking.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Dougong are not just decoration. They carry the roof, push the eaves far out, and soften earthquake shaking.

clips.send: Tonghui River. Guo Shoujing dug this canal from Tongzhou into the capital Dadu, so grain boats could sail right into the city. Kublai Khan named it “Tonghui”.
clips.text: Tonghui River. Guo Shoujing dug this canal from Tongzhou into the capital Dadu, so grain boats could sail right into the city. Kublai Khan named it “Tonghui”.

clips.send: Zhuojun. Today: Beijing. Emperor Yang of Sui sent troops and grain north to Zhuojun along the Yongji Canal. Later An Lushan started his rebellion from Fanyang.

clips.send: 应县木塔。今天：山西应县。木塔高约67米，全部用木材建造、不用一根铁钉，屹立九百多年，经受住了多次地震。
clips.text: 应县木塔。今天：山西应县。木塔高约67米，全部用木材建造、不用一根铁钉，屹立九百多年，经受住了多次地震。

clips.send: 榫卯。直榫（透榫）。方形的榫头穿过柱子上的卯眼。直榫。燕尾榫。拖动“组装”滑块，把梁头的榫插进柱子的卯眼。靠形状和摩擦咬紧，不用钉子也不用胶。地震时它能稍微转动、摩擦，吸收能量，过后又回到原位。

clips.send: 记忆口诀：凸出为“榫”，凹进为“卯”——“一凸一凹，不用钉子也牢靠”。 易错点：榫卯是一种连接方法；斗拱是由许多构件用榫卯拼成的一整组支架。

clips.send: 赵州桥。今天：河北赵县。赵州桥是世界上现存最古老的敞肩石拱桥，大拱上的小拱既能泄洪，又减轻了桥身重量。
clips.text: 赵州桥。今天：河北赵县。赵州桥是世界上现存最古老的敞肩石拱桥，大拱上的小拱既能泄洪，又减轻了桥身重量。

clips.send: 柱与额枋。已经立好：红色的柱子和柱头上的横梁。宫殿的柱子是整根的大木头，外面刷成红色。柱子立在石头柱础上，不埋进地里。

clips.send: 临清。运河在这里与卫河相接，明朝时临清是北方最繁华的商业城市之一。北京故宫的许多城砖就是在临清烧制、经运河运去的。

clips.send: 天津。天津濒临渤海，是北京的出海口。2008年起，京津城际高铁约30分钟连接两座城市。

clips.send: 记忆口诀：“斗托拱，拱托斗，层层出挑”：斗和拱一层层交替叠起，越往上伸得越远。 易错点：斗拱不只是装饰：它承托屋顶、把屋檐挑出去，还能缓冲地震的晃动。
